DhNmHhRd1z9zeGJ8HB8_Xg.zh: 南非今年截至9/22,累計報告22例確定病例,近期病例快速增加,以男性為主,主要分布於西開普省(Western Cape)18例,年齡介於23至50歲。當局持續加強監測與接觸者追蹤。 安哥拉今年9/23新增19例確定病例,自2024年11月中旬迄今年9/5,累計442例確定病例、2例死亡(致死率:0.45%),擴及11個省份。當局將加強監測、預防及診斷等防治措施,並提醒⺠眾出現相關症狀應立即就醫。
DhNmHhRd1z9zeGJ8HB8_Xg.en: South Africa had reported 22 confirmed mpox cases this year as of 22 September, with cases increasing rapidly in recent weeks. Most cases are male, with 18 in the Western Cape, and ages range from 23 to 50. Authorities continue to strengthen surveillance and contact tracing. Angola recorded 19 new confirmed cases on 23 September. From mid-November 2024 to 5 September this year, it has reported 442 confirmed cases and 2 deaths (case fatality rate: 0.45%), spread across 11 provinces. Authorities will strengthen prevention and control measures, including surveillance, prevention and diagnosis, and remind the public to seek medical care immediately if related symptoms appear.

hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.zh: WHO於9/29報告全球去(2025)年累計47個國家報告45萬1,499例病例,其中7,870例死亡,總病例數較2024年下降,惟死亡人數較2024年增加30%,為1999年以來最高之單年死亡數,疫情集中於安哥拉、孟加拉、剛果⺠主共和國、奈及利亞、南蘇丹、蘇丹及葉門等7國(占全球病例數與死亡數約90%),且非洲病例數與死亡數皆上升。WHO於今年重啟預防接種計畫,並表示口服疫苗年產量已提升至8,000萬劑,惟逾1/5死亡病例發生於醫療機構之外,突顯延誤就醫問題嚴重性,呼籲各國應加速投資安全水質與衛生等設施。
hwxNPIlYE0lMcqSs78p8eQ.en: On 29 September, WHO reported that in 2025, 47 countries cumulatively reported 451,499 cases, including 7,870 deaths. Total cases were lower than in 2024, but deaths rose 30% over 2024, the highest annual death toll since 1999. Cases were concentrated in seven countries (Angola, Bangladesh, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Nigeria, South Sudan, Sudan and Yemen), which together accounted for about 90% of global cases and deaths; cases and deaths both rose in Africa. WHO restarted vaccination programmes this year and stated that annual oral vaccine production has risen to 80 million doses. However, more than one in five deaths occurred outside health facilities, highlighting the serious problem of delayed care-seeking, and WHO called on countries to accelerate investment in safe water and sanitation.

97ggNQ2Zg923CL4wNf6COg.zh: 烏克蘭文察州(Vinnytsia Oblast)報告1例感染Ib型之成年男性病例,具歐洲旅遊史,病況輕微,目前已實施隔離,並針對接觸者進行21天健康監測,迄無新增病例。該國目前無本土傳播疫情,惟仍須嚴防來自其他歐洲國家之境外移入風險。 安哥拉卡賓達省(Cabinda)疫情由2024-25年之零星病例轉為持續社區傳播,目前爆發Ib型疫情。該國今年截至9/8累計264例確定病例,其中38例住院、2例死亡。個案以20-29歲(52%)及女性(66%)為主,多無旅遊史,主要經身體與性接觸傳播。當局已調撥3萬劑疫苗,針對醫護人員與高風險區⺠眾展開緊急接種防護。
97ggNQ2Zg923CL4wNf6COg.en: In Vinnytsia Oblast, Ukraine, one adult male infected with clade Ib, with a history of travel in Europe, has been reported; the case is mild. The patient has been isolated, and contacts are under 21 days of health monitoring; no new cases have been found. Ukraine currently has no local transmission, but must still guard strictly against imported cases from other European countries. In Cabinda Province, Angola, the outbreak has shifted from sporadic cases in 2024–25 to sustained community transmission, and a clade Ib outbreak is now under way. The country has reported 264 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 8 September, including 38 hospitalised and 2 deaths. Cases are mainly aged 20–29 (52%) and female (66%), most without travel history, and transmission is mainly through physical and sexual contact. Authorities have allocated 30,000 doses of vaccine for emergency vaccination of health workers and residents in high-risk areas.

_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年7/31累計145國/地區報告19萬683例確定病例,其中529例死亡。 今年7月共計32國家/地區報告1,370例確定病例,其中7例死亡(CFR:0.5%),以馬達加斯加(703例)、安哥拉(138例)、中國(88 例)、剛果⺠主共和國(55例)及肯亞(55例)為多,74.8%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年6月,全球病例數下降12.5%,僅非洲區呈上升趨勢,其餘地區下降;東南亞區及東地中海區則無通報病例。 全球已有68個國家/地區曾通報檢出Clade Ib確定病例,近6週(7/6-8/16)共有22國報告病例,其中15國出現本土社區傳播疫情,分布於非洲6國(馬達加斯加、安哥拉、肯亞、剛果⺠主共和國、南蘇丹、蒲隆地)及歐洲9國(葡萄牙、德國、法國、英國、愛爾蘭、荷蘭、義大利、瑞士及捷克)。 另馬達加斯加自2025年12月起迄今爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情。
_O23ZrgT4z3_SBc_TIlw-Q.en: Globally, since 2022 and as of 31 July this year, 145 countries and territories have cumulatively reported 190,683 confirmed cases, including 529 deaths. In July this year, 32 countries and territories reported 1,370 confirmed cases, including 7 deaths (CFR 0.5%); the largest numbers were in Madagascar (703), Angola (138), China (88), the DRC (55) and Kenya (55), and 74.8% of cases came from Africa. Compared with June this year, global cases fell by 12.5%; only Africa showed an increase, while other regions declined, and no cases were reported from South-East Asia or the Eastern Mediterranean region. A total of 68 countries and territories have ever reported confirmed clade Ib cases. In the past six weeks (6 July–16 August), 22 countries reported cases, of which 15 have local community transmission: six in Africa (Madagascar, Angola, Kenya, the DRC, South Sudan and Burundi) and nine in Europe (Portugal, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Ireland, the Netherlands, Italy, Switzerland and Czechia). Madagascar has been experiencing the largest clade Ib outbreak in the world since December 2025.

nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.zh: 全球自2022年截至今年6/30累計145國/地區報告18萬8,565例確定病例,其中521例死亡。 今年6月共計33國家/地區報告1,128例確定病例,其中9例死亡(CFR:0.8%),以馬達加斯加(546例)、美國(111例)、剛果⺠主共和國(86例)、英國(46例)及葡萄牙(45例)為高,64%病例來自非洲地區。相較今年5月,美洲區及東南亞區病例數呈上升趨勢,其餘地區疫情則下降;東地中海區則無通報病例。哥斯大黎加、迦納及立陶宛通報首例Ib型病例;幾內亞比索首度通報3例IIb型病例。 非洲地區近6週(6/8-7/19)共計10國報告1,112例確定病例,其中12例死亡(CFR:1.1%),以馬達加斯加(940例)、安哥拉(57例)、肯亞(48例)、剛果⺠主共和國(30例)及喀麥隆(24例)為高。 非洲以外地區,共11國報告Ib型社區傳播;近6週報告Ib型病例最多國家為葡萄牙(60例),其次為英國(31例)、泰國(29例)、法國(18例)及西班牙(16例)。 馬達加斯加自2025年12月起爆發全球最大規模Ib型疫情,截至7/19,累計報告2,921例確定病例及18例死亡(CFR:0.6%)。疫情擴及全國61%行政區(70/115),主要影響15-49歲族群。雖已推動MVA-BN疫苗接種(89,723人施打第1劑),惟因檢測陽性率由65%上升至74%,以及面臨疫苗缺貨、冷鏈物流、醫療量能與風險溝通等挑戰,疫情迄未受到控制。 安哥拉自今年5月中旬起疫情升溫,截至7/19累計108例確定病例及1例死亡(CFR 0.9%),主要集中於Cabinda省(佔80%),52%病例為20-29歲族群,其中女性及女童比例高達66%,當局已啟動相關防治措施。
nVUsMQAYFu4ybG_wrTQxoA.en: Globally, from 2022 through 30 June this year, 145 countries and territories have reported 188,565 confirmed mpox cases, including 521 deaths. In June this year, 33 countries and territories reported 1,128 confirmed cases, including 9 deaths (CFR: 0.8%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (546), the United States (111), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (86), the United Kingdom (46) and Portugal (45), and 64% of cases came from the African Region. Compared with May this year, case numbers rose in the Region of the Americas and the South-East Asia Region and declined in other regions; the Eastern Mediterranean Region reported no cases. Costa Rica, Ghana and Lithuania reported their first clade Ib cases, and Guinea-Bissau reported 3 clade IIb cases for the first time. In the African Region, over the past 6 weeks (8 June–19 July), 10 countries reported 1,112 confirmed cases, including 12 deaths (CFR: 1.1%). The highest numbers were in Madagascar (940), Angola (57), Kenya (48), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30) and Cameroon (24). Outside Africa, 11 countries have reported clade Ib community transmission. Over the past 6 weeks, the countries reporting the most clade Ib cases were Portugal (60), the United Kingdom (31), Thailand (29), France (18) and Spain (16). Madagascar has experienced the world's largest clade Ib outbreak since December 2025. As of 19 July, 2,921 confirmed cases and 18 deaths (CFR: 0.6%) have been reported cumulatively. The outbreak has spread to 61% of the country's administrative areas (70 of 115), mainly affecting people aged 15–49 years. Although MVA-BN vaccination has begun (89,723 people have received the first dose), the test positivity rate has risen from 65% to 74%, and challenges including vaccine shortages, cold chain logistics, health system capacity and risk communication remain, so the outbreak is not yet under control. Angola's outbreak has intensified since mid-May this year. As of 19 July, 108 confirmed cases and 1 death (CFR: 0.9%) have been reported cumulatively, mainly concentrated in Cabinda Province (80%). Of cases, 52% are aged 20–29 years, and females and girls account for as much as 66%. Authorities have launched related prevention and control measures.

mS8CXgt9DvXCnQEA5Kd0Eg.zh: 安哥拉馬蘭哲省(Malanje)今年截至6月累計報告逾52萬例病例,其中418例死亡,5歲以下兒童的死亡率最高, 病例數於近幾年呈大幅增加趨勢,並存在就醫延遲之情形。該國傳播高峰期通常在雨季期間及之後(10月至次年5月), 當局已預訂於今年年底進行疫苗接種活動。另該國2024年累計報告700萬例病例,其中1.1 萬例死亡。
mS8CXgt9DvXCnQEA5Kd0Eg.en: In Malanje Province, Angola, more than 520,000 malaria cases have been reported cumulatively this year through June, including 418 deaths. The death rate is highest among children under 5 years. Case numbers have increased sharply in recent years, and delays in seeking care have been observed. Transmission usually peaks during and after the rainy season (October to May of the following year). Authorities have scheduled a vaccination campaign for the end of this year. In addition, the country reported 7 million cases in 2024, including 11,000 deaths.

YDRE_uMnHEIt6rRXBhu5Pw.zh: 安哥拉自 2024 年至 2026/5/29,全國累計 13 例確定病例,主要分布於接壤剛果民主共和國(DRC)的卡賓達省(9 例)與烏伊熱省(4 例)。卡賓達近期新通報 3 例均為無旅遊史個案,顯示已發生本土社區傳播,惟病毒分支類型尚待確認。目前該國 MVA-BN 疫苗優先提供給邊境警察接種,一般社區民眾則缺乏保護力。
YDRE_uMnHEIt6rRXBhu5Pw.en: From 2024 to 29 May 2026, Angola has reported 13 confirmed cases nationwide, mainly in Cabinda Province (9) and Uíge Province (4), both bordering the DRC. The three newly reported cases in Cabinda had no travel history, indicating local community transmission, although the virus clade has yet to be confirmed. The MVA-BN vaccine is currently prioritised for border police, leaving the general community without protection.

E5OUYwmPNlbc9R4BBSFotg.zh: WHO 公布全球今年截至 4/26 累計報告 7 萬 9,740 例病例,1,010 例死亡,其中,4 月新增病例數較今年 3 月下降 54%,且較去年同期下降 62%,各國 CFR 介於 0-8.9%。病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞及美洲共 22 個國家,近期新增病例以剛果民主共和國、阿富汗、安哥拉及南蘇丹為多。WHO 評估約有 10 億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
E5OUYwmPNlbc9R4BBSFotg.en: WHO reports that globally, as of 26 April this year, 79,740 cases and 1,010 deaths have been reported cumulatively. New cases in April fell 54% from March this year and 62% from the same period last year. CFR across countries ranges from 0% to 8.9%. Cases are distributed across 22 countries in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia and the Americas. Recent new cases are mainly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Afghanistan, Angola and South Sudan. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face infection risk, and the global transmission risk is very high.

QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)疫情持續擴大,截至5/24累計報告112例確診及11例死亡、906例疑病例及223例疑病例死亡,主要分布於伊圖里省、北基伍省及南基伍省;烏干達迄今累積報告7例確診,其中1例死亡;義大利出現2例疑病例,在烏干達擔任為期三個月的援助工作人員,返回義國後,出現高燒、嘔吐、腹瀉和噁心等疑症狀,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。非洲CDC評估有11個國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、南蘇丹、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、坦尚亞、尚比亞及索馬利亞。
QtLreGnLRjsuNX-GxBG0pw.en: The outbreak in the DRC continues to expand: as of 24 May, 112 confirmed cases and 11 deaths, plus 906 suspected cases and 223 suspected deaths, had been reported cumulatively, mainly in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has reported seven confirmed cases cumulatively, one of which was fatal. Italy reported two suspected cases involving an aid worker who had spent three months in Uganda. After returning to Italy, the person developed suspected symptoms including high fever, vomiting, diarrhoea and nausea, but tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases in Italy. The Africa CDC assesses that 11 countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, South Sudan, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, Tanzania, Zambia and Somalia.

sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.zh: 剛果民主共和國(DRC)及烏干達疫情持續擴大,疫情主要分布於DRC伊圖里與北基伍省,兩國截至5/23累計報告91例確診及10例死亡、867例疑病例及204例疑病例死亡,且匡列1,261名接觸者。DRC伊圖里省傳出3名紅十字會志工染病死亡,南基伍省(South Kivu)亦於5/20通報首例28歲死亡確診個案。烏干達迄今累積報告5例確診,其中1例死亡。另南蘇丹澄清其境內疑病例,經檢測結果為陰性,無確診病例。 WHO指出疫情在5/15通報前恐已隱匿傳播數週或數月,導致疫情蔓延至多個省份。非洲CDC評估有10個非洲國家面臨傳播風險,包含安哥拉、蒲隆地、中非共和國、剛果共和國、衣索比亞、肯亞、盧安達、南蘇丹、坦尚亞及尚比亞。 WHO緊急委員會第一次會議臨時建議,評估剛果民主共和國風險為「非常高」,烏干達及區域風險為「高」,全球風險為「低」。建議疫區國家啟動國家災害或突發事件管理機制,並執行包括加強監測等防控措施;區域層級國家應建立與地方各層級相銜接的國家協調機制制定相關措施;其他國家對來自已記錄到病毒(BDBV)感染地區出現不明原因發熱症狀的旅行者進行檢測、評估、報告及管理,執行公眾之疫情風險溝通等。
sncrUtYerCGCwrfk3ZssMA.en: The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda continues to expand, mainly in Ituri and North Kivu provinces of the DRC. As of 23 May, the two countries had reported 91 confirmed cases and 10 deaths, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, and 1,261 contacts had been listed. In Ituri Province, DRC, three Red Cross volunteers were reported to have died after infection. South Kivu Province reported its first confirmed case, a death in a 28-year-old, on 20 May. Uganda has reported five cumulative confirmed cases, one of which was fatal. South Sudan clarified that a suspected case in its territory tested negative, so there are no confirmed cases there. WHO notes that the outbreak may have spread silently for several weeks or months before it was reported on 15 May, leading to spread across multiple provinces. The Africa CDC assesses that 10 African countries face transmission risk: Angola, Burundi, the Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia. The first meeting of the WHO Emergency Committee provisionally assessed the risk as very high for the DRC, high for Uganda and at regional level, and low globally. It recommends that affected countries activate national disaster or emergency management mechanisms and implement control measures, including enhanced surveillance; that countries in the region establish national coordination mechanisms linked to local levels; and that other countries test, assess, report and manage travellers with unexplained fever who have been in areas where Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) infection has been recorded, and communicate public health risks.

dPF6pz0YCJAp3gazmNLZlQ.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/12-18期間,WPV1新增阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為奈及利亞2例、安哥拉/索馬利亞各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增2國共27件,分別為阿富汗20件、巴基斯坦7件,cVDPV2新增2國共2件,分別為查德/索馬利亞各1件。
dPF6pz0YCJAp3gazmNLZlQ.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 12–18 March, WPV1 added one case in Afghanistan. cVDPV2 added four cases in three countries: two in Nigeria, and one each in Angola and Somalia. For environmental samples, WPV1 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling 27 samples: 20 in Afghanistan and seven in Pakistan. cVDPV2 detections were newly reported in two countries, totalling two samples: one each in Chad and Somalia.

WGBESEL7gduXJsRKPB5NYw.zh: 非洲2025年截至12/21累計報告逾31萬例病例,其中約3,000例死亡,有88%的病患居住在南蘇丹、蘇丹、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉及奈及利亞,非洲CDC提出整合性策略以對抗疫情;另全球每年約有130-400萬人感染,造成2-14萬人死亡。
WGBESEL7gduXJsRKPB5NYw.en: In Africa, cumulative cases in 2025 up to 21 December exceeded 310,000, of which about 3,000 died. 88% of patients lived in South Sudan, Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Angola and Nigeria. The Africa CDC has proposed an integrated strategy to combat the outbreak. Globally, an estimated 1.3–4 million people are infected each year, causing 20,000–140,000 deaths.

Afe9_Rviq5y1twRiHzmHSA.zh: 寮國沙灣拿吉省(Savannakhet)於12/12確診1例cVDPV1病例,為3歲個案,於9/3出現急性肢體無力症狀,並在其病毒檢體中發現31個基因突變點,推估已在該國傳播大約3年,另有2例相關病例檢測中;因本案鄰近越南邊界且往來密切,WHO評估越南面臨極高輸入及再出現病例風險,該國已召開全國緊急會議並加強監測。 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於12/4-10期間,cVDPV2新增3國共4例,分別為安哥拉2例、奈及利亞/葉門各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增索馬利亞2件。
Afe9_Rviq5y1twRiHzmHSA.en: Savannakhet province in Laos confirmed one cVDPV1 case on 12 December, in a 3-year-old child who developed acute limb weakness on 3 September. The viral sample showed 31 genetic mutation sites, and the virus is estimated to have circulated in the country for about three years; two related cases are being tested. Because this case is near the Viet Nam border with close cross-border movement, WHO assesses that Viet Nam faces a very high risk of importation and re-emergence of cases. The country has convened a national emergency meeting and strengthened surveillance. The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 4–10 December that cVDPV2 added 4 cases in 3 countries: 2 in Angola, and 1 each in Nigeria and Yemen. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 2 samples in Somalia.

j_lKeLCnvvYzMb-Zsg-naw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於11/27-12/3期間,cVDPV2新增2國共3例,分別為剛果民主共和國2例、安哥拉1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增2國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞7件、查德2件。
j_lKeLCnvvYzMb-Zsg-naw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported for 27 November–3 December that cVDPV2 added 3 cases in 2 countries: 2 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and 1 in Angola. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 added 9 samples in 2 countries: 7 in Papua New Guinea and 2 in Chad.

UNHbWKTQg4Jp81s2zaylwg.zh: WHO公布全球今年截至10月累計報告逾56萬例病例,約7,000例死亡,其中,10月新增報告約3.5萬例,較9月下降34%,各國CFR介於0-8.2%;病例分布於東地中海、非洲、東南亞、美洲、西太平洋共32個國家/地區,近期新增病例以葉門、剛果民主共和國、安哥拉為多,目前口服疫苗庫存量高於緊急需求數。WHO評估約有10億人口面臨感染風險,全球傳播風險為非常高。
UNHbWKTQg4Jp81s2zaylwg.en: The WHO reports that globally, as of October this year, more than 560,000 cases and about 7,000 deaths have been reported cumulatively. In October, about 35,000 new cases were reported, a 34% decrease from September, and national case fatality rates range from 0 to 8.2%. Cases have been distributed across 32 countries and areas in the Eastern Mediterranean, Africa, South-East Asia, the Americas and the Western Pacific. Recent new cases are concentrated in Yemen, the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Angola. Current oral vaccine stocks exceed emergency demand. WHO estimates that about 1 billion people face the risk of infection, and the global transmission risk is very high.

sYZh5hKIBF1EDNjxPuXOJg.zh: 非洲CDC表示今年疫情為本世紀最嚴峻,非洲各國今年迄今累計約30萬例確定及疑病例,其中逾7,000例死亡,病例數較去年增加30%;其中安哥拉今年截至11/12累計報告約3.4萬例病例及874例死亡(CFR:2.5%),疫情自10月底再度攀升,另該國去年無病例數。
sYZh5hKIBF1EDNjxPuXOJg.en: The Africa CDC says this year's outbreak is the most severe this century. Across African countries, about 300,000 confirmed and suspected cases have been reported cumulatively this year, of which more than 7,000 died, and case numbers are 30% higher than last year. In Angola, about 34,000 cases and 874 deaths (CFR 2.5%) have been reported cumulatively as of 12 November this year. The outbreak has surged again since late October, and the country reported no cases last year.

5dNk7QZ9HbVP89bVZ5qAHw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/23-29期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增3國共10例,分別為奈及利亞7例、安哥拉2例、巴布亞紐幾內亞1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦12件,cVDPV2新增5國共9件,分別為巴布亞紐幾內亞5件、安哥拉/查德/奈及利亞/索馬利亞各1件。
5dNk7QZ9HbVP89bVZ5qAHw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 23–29 October, WPV1 added one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 added 10 cases across three countries: 7 in Nigeria, 2 in Angola and 1 in Papua New Guinea. For environmental samples, WPV1 added 12 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 added 9 samples across five countries: 5 in Papua New Guinea, and one each in Angola, Chad, Nigeria and Somalia.

QuVdC98S2DNwU5ZPKgOGRg.zh: 以色列疫情持續,近1週報告4例兒童死亡案例,今年迄今已累計報告6例死亡,該國今年4月爆發疫情,截至9月中旬累計報告超過1,200例,病例多集中於該國中/北部地區。 安哥拉今年迄今累計報告逾6,000例,全國所有省分均有通報病例,該國疫苗覆蓋率已超過70%,惟農村地區及郊區覆蓋率仍低,該國仍持續存在社區傳播風險。 美國今年截至9/23共42州報告1,514例,其中185例住院、3例死亡,並報告40起疫情。新墨西哥州宣布疫情結束,該州自今年2/14爆發疫情,累計報告100例,為該州1996年以來首次爆發疫情,亦為數十年以來最大規模疫情。
QuVdC98S2DNwU5ZPKgOGRg.en: Israel: The outbreak continues. In the past week, four child deaths were reported, bringing the cumulative number of deaths this year to six. The outbreak began in April this year, and as of mid-September more than 1,200 cases had been reported cumulatively, mainly in the central and northern parts of the country. Angola: More than 6,000 cases have been reported so far this year, with cases reported in all provinces of the country. Vaccination coverage has exceeded 70%, but coverage remains low in rural and suburban areas, and the risk of community transmission persists. United States: As of 23 September this year, 1,514 cases had been reported from 42 states, including 185 hospitalizations and 3 deaths, and 40 outbreaks had been reported. New Mexico has declared its outbreak over. The state's outbreak began on 14 February this year, with 100 cases reported cumulatively; it was the state's first outbreak since 1996 and the largest in decades.

g8I3gjnuCs8GJ-d8-dIeWA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/28-9/3期間,WPV1新增2國共4例,分別為巴基斯坦3例、阿富汗1例;cVDPV2新增4國共5例,分別為安哥拉2例、查德/奈及利亞/巴布亞紐幾內亞(前已掌握)各1例。
g8I3gjnuCs8GJ-d8-dIeWA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 28 August–3 September, wild poliovirus type 1 (WPV1) increased by four cases in two countries: Pakistan (3) and Afghanistan (1). cVDPV2 increased by five cases in four countries: Angola (2), and Chad, Nigeria and Papua New Guinea (1 each; previously identified).

dSjEaxSkzroRgkZ0V0v8Ew.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於8/14-20期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦2例;cVDPV1新增剛果民主共和國1例;cVDPV2新增3國共28例,分別為葉門26例、安哥拉/中非共和國各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1新增巴基斯坦42件,cVDPV2新增坦尚亞1件。
dSjEaxSkzroRgkZ0V0v8Ew.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that during 14–20 August, WPV1 increased by two cases in Pakistan, and circulating vaccine-derived poliovirus type 1 (cVDPV1) increased by one case in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. cVDPV2 increased by 28 cases in three countries: Yemen (26), and Angola and the Central African Republic (1 each). For environmental samples, WPV1 increased by 42 samples in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 by one sample in Tanzania.

heCV6GcQnopNMLqt7ERGhA.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於6/26-7/2期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例;cVDPV2新增2國共2例,分別為安哥拉/查德各1例;環境樣本部分,cVDPV2新增貝南1件。
heCV6GcQnopNMLqt7ERGhA.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 26 June and 2 July, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan. cVDPV2 increased by 2 cases in 2 countries, one each in Angola and Chad. For environmental samples, cVDPV2 increased by one sample in Benin.

z6xhILcTyF1Yo0AEKZsA9w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於5/29-6/4期間,WPV1新增巴基斯坦1例,cVDPV2新增5國共15例,分別為衣索比亞8例、葉門3例、查德2例、安哥拉/日各1例;環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦2件,cVDPV2型陽性樣本增加2國共4件,分別為吉布地3件、索馬利亞1件。
z6xhILcTyF1Yo0AEKZsA9w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 29 May and 4 June, WPV1 increased by one case in Pakistan, and cVDPV2 increased by 15 cases in 5 countries: 8 in Ethiopia, 3 in Yemen, 2 in Chad, and 1 each in Angola and Niger. For environmental samples, WPV1-positive samples increased by 2 in Pakistan, and cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Djibouti and 1 in Somalia.

d4taZDeL2z5QmKPkxLSP5w.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於4/3-9期間,cVDPV2型新增2國共4例,分別為衣索比亞3例、安哥拉1例。環境樣本部分,cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增2國共2件,分別為以色列/象牙海岸各1件。
d4taZDeL2z5QmKPkxLSP5w.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 April, cVDPV2 cases increased by 4 in 2 countries: 3 in Ethiopia and 1 in Angola. For environmental samples, cVDPV2-positive samples increased by 2 in 2 countries, 1 each in Israel and Côte d'Ivoire.

zb7aWVDMoExHVFnVbHBbhw.zh: 非洲疫情持續且呈區域擴散趨勢,非洲區署公布第14週(3/31- 4/6)疫情,其中,安哥拉新增1,164例病例,其中25例死亡(CFR:2%),疫情擴散至17個省份;衣索比亞疫情回升,新增322例病例,疫情主要於西北及西南部省分;迦納新增30例病例,較前週減少62%,集中於中部地區。WHO呼籲受影響國家強化飲水衛生、疫苗及治療等防疫措施。
zb7aWVDMoExHVFnVbHBbhw.en: The outbreak in Africa continues and is spreading regionally. The WHO Regional Office for Africa published data for week 14 (31 March–6 April): in Angola, 1,164 new cases were reported, including 25 deaths (CFR 2%), and the outbreak has spread to 17 provinces. In Ethiopia the outbreak has resurged, with 322 new cases, mainly in the north-western and south-western provinces. Ghana reported 30 new cases, a 62% decrease from the previous week, concentrated in the central region. WHO calls on affected countries to strengthen preventive measures such as water and sanitation hygiene, vaccination and treatment.

ALA8XIETwIu5MeA5OjRfQQ.zh: 安哥拉疫情持續且嚴峻,自今年初截至3/23累計16省報告8,543例病例,其中329例死亡(CFR:3.9%),約30%死亡數發生在社區,2月單週病例逾1,000例,達高峰後下降,惟於近期單週再達1,200例高峰。病患分布於盧安達省為多,本戈省次之,多為6-14歲族群(佔21.7%)。WHO表示當地公衛介入措施不足、延遲通報、當地雨季加劇傳播風險,且位處交通要道並與鄰國尚比亞及剛果民主共和國接壤,評估該國和鄰國傳播風險為非常高。另今年迄3/23累計3區署24國報告9 3,172例病例,其中1,197例死亡。
ALA8XIETwIu5MeA5OjRfQQ.en: Angola's outbreak continues and is severe. From the start of the year to 23 March, 8,543 cases and 329 deaths (CFR: 3.9%) were reported from 16 provinces, and about 30% of deaths occurred in the community. Weekly cases exceeded 1,000 in February and then declined after peaking, but recently reached a new weekly peak of 1,200. Most cases are in Luanda Province, followed by Benguela Province; most patients are aged 6–14 years (21.7%). WHO notes insufficient local public health interventions, delayed reporting and rainy-season conditions that increase transmission risk. The country sits on major transport routes and borders Zambia and the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO assesses the transmission risk for Angola and its neighbours as very high. Also, from the start of the year to 23 March, 24 countries across 3 WHO regions reported 93,172 cases, of which 1,197 were deaths.

CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於3/13-19期間,新增報告cVDPV2型新增3國共6例病例,分別為索馬利亞4例、安哥拉/奈及利亞各1例。環境樣本部分,WPV1型陽性樣本新增巴基斯坦12件;cVDPV2型陽性樣本新增7國共13件,分別為葉門5件、吉布地3件、安哥拉/查德/象牙海岸/衣索比亞/索馬利亞各1件。
CA9elNAIcTMjDeXj9nGhqw.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 13 and 19 March, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported in 3 countries: 4 in Somalia, and 1 each in Angola and Nigeria. For environmental samples, 12 new WPV1-positive samples were reported in Pakistan. 13 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported in 7 countries: 5 in Yemen, 3 in Djibouti, and 1 each in Angola, Chad, Côte d'Ivoire, Ethiopia and Somalia.

v780hgwLFQYBCmZCGQnWAQ.zh: 歐洲報告自今年迄2月底累計2國7例病例,分別為英國4例、德國3例,病患曾去衣索比亞或接觸衣國阿姆哈拉區之聖水,其中5例報告曾飲用來自疫區之瓶裝水,該瓶裝水亦檢測出病原,當局提醒旅客前往該國或接觸疫區之瓶裝水皆有感染風險。 安哥拉疫情持續升高,自1/7宣布爆發後,截至3月中旬已累計13省5,872例病例,其中937例確診、208例死亡,15歲以下兒童佔病例/死亡數之39%及35%。
v780hgwLFQYBCmZCGQnWAQ.en: Europe has reported 7 cholera cases in 2 countries from the start of this year to the end of February: 4 in the United Kingdom and 3 in Germany. The patients had travelled to Ethiopia or had consumed holy water from the Amhara Region of Ethiopia. Five cases reported drinking bottled water from an affected area, and the bottled water also tested positive for the pathogen. Authorities warn that travellers to Ethiopia, and bottled water from the affected areas, carry a risk of infection. Cholera in Angola continues to rise. Since the outbreak was declared on 7 January, 5,872 cases have been reported cumulatively from 13 provinces as of mid-March, including 937 confirmed cases and 208 deaths. Children under 15 account for 39% of cases and 35% of deaths.

5FqFWiPWIyoqrsjQQxbKcQ.zh: 安哥拉疫情持續上升,2025年迄1/15累計報告332例病例,其中66例確診,20例死亡(CFR:6%),多集中於該國西北部魯安達省。病患多為兒童及青少年,佔比最多為0-9歲(32.2%)、10-19歲(24.6%)次之,死者半數為10歲以下兒童。
5FqFWiPWIyoqrsjQQxbKcQ.en: Angola's outbreak continues to rise. From the beginning of 2025 to 15 January, 332 cases were reported cumulatively, of which 66 were confirmed, with 20 deaths (CFR 6%), mostly concentrated in Luanda Province in the northwest of the country. Patients are mainly children and adolescents; the largest share is aged 0–9 years (32.2%), followed by 10–19 years (24.6%). Half of the deaths were children under 10.

zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.zh: 非洲疫情持續,第1週累計4國報告339例病例,其中61例確診,5例死亡(CFR:1.2%);分別是迦納累計報告297例病例,3例死亡;辛巴威累計24例(無人死亡);馬拉威累計14例病例(2例死亡);尚比亞累計4例病例(無人死亡)。 安哥拉疫情上升,2025年迄第2週累計3省報告224例,其中32例確診,18例死亡(CFR:8%),病患年齡涵蓋2-70歲,且女性占比54%,該國上次爆發疫情為2018年(累計1,262例病例,19例死亡,CFR:1.5%)。 非洲2024年全年報告累計20國,共235,387例病例,其中30,583確診,3,747例死亡(CFR:1.59%),累計病例數國家前五名依序為蘇丹(51,615例)、剛果民主共和國(30,373例)、衣索比亞(26,052例)、索馬利亞(21,739例)、尚比亞(20,076例)。
zVz9cO2-Hgs2r52mNnJLkA.en: The outbreak in Africa continues. In week 1, four countries cumulatively reported 339 cases, of which 61 were confirmed, and 5 deaths (CFR 1.2%): Ghana 297 cases and 3 deaths; Zimbabwe 24 cases (no deaths); Malawi 14 cases (2 deaths); and Zambia 4 cases (no deaths). Angola's outbreak is increasing: as of week 2 of 2025, three provinces had reported 224 cases cumulatively, including 32 confirmed and 18 deaths (CFR 8%). Patients are aged 2–70, and women account for 54%. The country's previous outbreak was in 2018 (1,262 cases and 19 deaths, CFR 1.5%). In 2024, Africa reported 235,387 cases in 20 countries cumulatively, including 30,583 confirmed and 3,747 deaths (CFR 1.59%). The five countries with the most cumulative cases were Sudan (51,615), the Democratic Republic of the Congo (30,373), Ethiopia (26,052), Somalia (21,739) and Zambia (20,076).

RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.zh: 全球小兒麻痺根除倡議組織(GPEI)公布於10/3-10/9期間,巴基斯坦新增4例WPV1病例;共3國新增6例cVDPV2病例,分別為奈及利亞4例、安哥拉/南蘇丹各1例。環境樣本部分,巴基斯坦新增50件WPV1陽性樣本;共4國新增8件cVDPV2陽性樣本,分別為日4件、南蘇丹2件、西班牙/葉門各1件;法屬圭亞那新增3件cVDPV3陽性樣本。 全球今年WPV1病例累計50例,其中巴基斯坦28例、阿富汗22例,疾病仍持續傳播並造成兒童健康風險。
RAZen0Fms8bDx5DZg8eh3g.en: The Global Polio Eradication Initiative (GPEI) reported that between 3 and 9 October, Pakistan recorded 4 new WPV1 cases. Across 3 countries, 6 new cVDPV2 cases were reported: Nigeria 4, and Angola and South Sudan 1 each. For environmental samples, Pakistan recorded 50 new WPV1-positive samples. Across 4 countries, 8 new cVDPV2-positive samples were reported: Japan 4, South Sudan 2, and Spain and Yemen 1 each. French Guiana recorded 3 new cVDPV3-positive samples. Globally this year, cumulative WPV1 cases total 50, including 28 in Pakistan and 22 in Afghanistan. The disease continues to spread and poses health risks to children.
